title: The Confidence view remembers your choices and shows a legend
items: Presets, hidden grades, colours, looks and opacity now come back when you reload, and when you Jump to another year. Before, the colouring itself was forgotten.
While the Confidence view is on, a small chip by the year chip shows a dot for each grade in the colour it wears. Tap it to open the Confidence view.
If your browser won't save anything, the view simply opens at Normal.
